title: Frost & Silver standalone wage-food budget: retained computational rerun
status_basis: game-change-review: 'reproduced' requires a rerun from the recorded inputs by someone other than the author. Only the author has rerun this package; no such rerun has been recorded yet.
analysis_type: retrospective computational rerun after the earlier results were read; no new confirmatory test
blind_test: No. Committing the inputs before the run adds no evidential weight: the model is deterministic and its results were published in the 19 November report before this package existed.
historical_validation: not performed; inherited source readings, assumptions and limitations are unchanged
execution_time: No wall-clock timestamps are recorded, so that generate rewrites this manifest byte for byte; the run is identified by the harness commit and the Git commit that adds this manifest.

model.kind: standalone household budget, not the classroom game engine
model.repository_snapshot_note: Repository snapshot (the merge of PR #23), not the commit that introduced the model.
model.game_path_not_applicable: This model never loads or executes projects/02/index.html.

runtime.python_full_version: 3.14.10 | packaged by Anaconda, Inc. | (main, Oct 27 2026, 01:09:10) [MSC v.1942 64 bit (AMD64)]

randomness.quantiles: statistics.quantiles(values, n=20), default exclusive method; positions 0 and 18
randomness.randomness: CPython random.Random (MT19937), model lhs() with shuffle and uniform jitter; parameter insertion order matters
randomness.pairing: One identical six-parameter draw is evaluated in each case. No case consumes random draws.

draw_id.meaning: 1-based paired parameter-draw index, not a household observation

cost_per_week.meaning: worker costs, charged for all 26 weeks

kcal_per_real.meaning: food purchasing-power assumption; not a validated historical price

ration_kcal_per_day.meaning: worker ration saved by the household while away

farm_forgone_kcal.meaning: food forgone from the worker's absent farm labour

mita_dfood_kcal.meaning: signed food-equivalent difference from farming at home

hired_dfood_kcal.meaning: signed food-equivalent difference from farming at home

mixed_dfood_kcal.meaning: signed food-equivalent difference from farming at home

summary.share_food_rises.meaning: positive outcomes / 1000 parameter draws, not an observed frequency or population probability

summary.diagnostic.hired_when_it_pays.meaning: [minimum, median] over the paying hired draws, not a range; see the package README

terminal_accounting: One household, one adult worker, one 26-week season. Net wages less all 26 weeks of worker costs are converted to food-equivalent kcal; add the worker ration saved at home and subtract farm output forgone. Negative cash is a food-equivalent shortfall, not debt carried forward. No game settlement is executed.
threshold: Full-precision dfood > 0; exact zeros are not gains.
quantile_method: statistics.quantiles(values, n=20), default exclusive method; positions 0 and 18
files_scope: The pinned model and this package's own members only. Context documents are pinned by commit and Git blob in lifecycle.sources.context_documents. Pinned by commit and Git blob, never hashed in the working tree: these files are living repository documents (pre-registrations take appended deviations; LICENSE.md takes a row per game).
manifest_self_hash: Excluded to avoid a recursive hash; cite the immutable Git revision of the complete package.
preservation: Versioned Git package; no independent scholarly archive or DOI has been established.

outcome.metric: signed household food-equivalent change, kcal per 26-week season
outcome.unit_of_comparison: one paired parameter draw evaluated in all three cases; not an observed household
outcome.definitions: data_dictionary, terminal_accounting, threshold and counts_by_case in this manifest

prior_predictions.hypothesis_kind: standalone budget-model predictions relevant to a teaching assumption, not a gameplay validation
prior_predictions.blind_test: No. Committing the inputs before the run adds no evidential weight: the model is deterministic and its results were published in the 19 November report before this package existed.
prior_predictions.scope: Only the quantitative part of each pre-registered prediction is encoded. P2's qualitative clause ('only with many paid weeks, low costs and high kcal per real') is not encoded; see the package README.

pre_registered.interpretation: '10-35% of draws' read as an inclusive interval on the positive share.

predictions.reason: The hired positive share is outside the predeclared 10-35% interval.
No positive break-even food price exists at the midpoint parameters: worker costs exceed wages there.

lifecycle.history_policy: The pre-registration and the 19 November report are not edited. Later findings are added as new dated records; failed predictions stay recorded as failed.
